course_name: 人本設計：創新創業設計思考跨域
outline:
本課程的目的是幫助學生發展創新和創業思維能力。本課程是以美國巴布森學院的創新創業課程為基礎。它使學生能夠快速了解創業所需的知識和技能，例如創業思維方式，自我理解，人際網絡，商業模式等能力。並在跨領域雙師的指導下，學習跨領域設計思考和溝通技巧的核心概念。我們希望本課程可以培訓新時代的跨學通才，並提高他們的競爭力。此課程為未來進入職涯架構接軌機制，也為產業注入強而有力的新能量。
The purpose of this course is to help students to develop innovation and entrepreneurial thinking ability. The course is based on the entrepreneurship program courses from Babson College in the United States. It allows students to quickly understand the knowledge and skills needed for entrepreneurship such as mindset of entrepreneurship, self-understanding, network, business models, and to deliver the core concept of interdisciplinary design thinking and communication skills under the teaching of dual-instructors. We expect that this course can train new era interdisciplinary polymaths and enhance their competitiveness. This course also integrates students into the career track in the near future, and inject new power into the industry which is benefit to the society.
